title: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.08311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIA

translated_title: 基于大语言模型辅助的标签噪声纠正用于脑电图睡眠分期分类
translated_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）信号的自动睡眠分期是临床睡眠医学中的一项关键任务。尽管深度学习模型在该领域已展现出可观的效果，但其性能从根本上受限于训练标签的质量——这些标签由人类专家手动标注，容易受到评分者之间意见分歧和系统性标注错误的影响。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的LLM辅助标签噪声过滤流程，该流程仅在训练阶段运行，用于在重新训练分类器之前识别并移除不可靠的睡眠阶段标注。具体而言，首先在原始数据集上训练TinySleepNet以提取每个epoch的SoftMax置信度分数，然后将低置信度的epoch连同其EEG频谱特征和周围序列上下文一起提交给LLaMA 3.1。该LLM根据AASM睡眠评分指南对每个epoch进行评估，并给出可靠性判定。
tldr: 本文提出一种利用大语言模型（LLaMA 3.1）在训练阶段识别并过滤不可靠睡眠分期标注的新流程，通过模型置信度筛选结合EEG频谱特征与AASM评分指南评估，有效纠正标签噪声从而提升基于脑电图的睡眠分期分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that leverages TinySleepNet confidence scores and LLaMA 3.1 evaluation against AASM guidelines to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations during training, improving EEG-based sleep stage classification.
